headline: Binance Hacker Splits $1.4 Billion in Bitcoin Across 19 Unfreezable Wallets
summary: A hacker distributed 18,270 bitcoin worth approximately $1.4 billion into 19 unfreezable wallets. Blockchain tracking indicates 17 wallets hold exactly 1,000 BTC each, with no movement recorded since Thursday night.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges. Large-scale security breaches and movements of stolen digital assets can create market uncertainty and regulatory scrutiny across the crypto sector.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Movement of large sums of stolen bitcoin can create supply overhang concerns if liquidated.
